proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 6, proof of Theorem 5.1, displays (29)–(30) and (34) (book/chapter-06.txt lines 1862–1906), as written out in the parent-supplied proof of cmcdtfr_face_integral_current (its facts (F1)–(F2) and steps 1–5). This child is fact (F1) of that proof, together with the coefficient comparison in the second bullet of its step 4.
1. Notation. For J : Fin k → Fin P let f(J) := α(e_J)² if J is strictly increasing and f(J) := 0 otherwise. Since EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ l = EuclideanSpace.single l 1 = e_l (EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply), the definition of covectorEuclideanNorm reads |α| = √S with S := Σ_{J : Fin k → Fin P} f(J) (sum over the finite type of all maps Fin k → Fin P). Each f(J) is a square or 0, so f(J) ≥ 0, S ≥ 0 and |α|² = S (Real.sq_sqrt).
2. Proof of (i). Let I be strictly increasing. Then f(I) = α(e_I)². All terms of S are nonnegative, so the single term f(I) is at most the whole sum (Finset.single_le_sum): α(e_I)² ≤ S. Hence |α(e_I)| ≤ √S = |α| (Real.abs_le_sqrt).
3. Proof of (ii), the faces are strictly increasing. Let ι : Fin (k+1) → Fin P be strictly increasing and, for i ∈ Fin (k+1), put J_i := ι ∘ i.succAbove : Fin k → Fin P. The map i.succAbove is strictly increasing (Fin.strictMono_succAbove), so J_i is strictly increasing as a composition of strictly increasing maps. Therefore f(J_i) = α(e_{J_i})² = α(e_{ι(i.succAbove 0)}, …, e_{ι(i.succAbove (k−1))})², which is the i-th summand on the left side of (ii).
4. The faces are pairwise distinct. Suppose J_i = J_{i'}. Then ι(i.succAbove j) = ι(i'.succAbove j) for every j ∈ Fin k; ι is injective (StrictMono.injective), so i.succAbove = i'.succAbove as functions, and therefore i = i' (Fin.succAbove_left_injective). So i ↦ J_i is injective.
5. Comparison. Let T ⊆ (Fin k → Fin P) be the image of Fin (k+1) under i ↦ J_i. By steps 3–4 and Finset.sum_image, Σ_i α(e_{J_i})² = Σ_i f(J_i) = Σ_{J ∈ T} f(J). Since T is a subset of all maps and f ≥ 0, Σ_{J ∈ T} f(J) ≤ Σ_J f(J) = S = |α|² (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg). This is (ii). ∎
key_steps: |α|² = S := Σ_J f(J) with f(J) = α(e_J)² on strictly increasing J and 0 otherwise (basisFun_apply), all terms ≥ 0.
(i): the single term f(I) ≤ S, then |α(e_I)| ≤ √S by Real.abs_le_sqrt.
(ii): J_i = ι ∘ i.succAbove is strictly increasing and i ↦ J_i is injective (ι injective, succAbove_left_injective).
(ii): Σ_i f(J_i) is the sub-sum of S over the image of i ↦ J_i, hence ≤ S = |α|².
